verdict.rationale: Sales Cloud's pricing page lists "Built-in Sales Flows and Lead Routing", the platform references Flows as a native automation asset, and a community user reports building a timed email in SFDC within minutes, so first-party workflow automation exists. The evidence does not show the specific trigger, record-update, task-creation and notification actions the story asks for. Missing for 10: documentation of record-change triggers, automatic record updates, task creation, notification actions, and an ops-user builder experience.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can build trigger-based workflows that update records, create tasks, and send notifications automatically
